content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The agreement has no post-termination transition or data-return obligation running to AbbVie. Article 12's exit mechanics (12.6 reversion, 12.7 Harpoon Reversion Products, 12.10.2 sell-off) all run toward Harpoon, and the only return mechanic — Section 9.7 — is request-based, permits Harpoon to destroy rather than deliver, and has no deadline. Harpoon's assistance obligations elsewhere (Sections 3.12, 4.x, 7.x) are in-Term only.

Classified as **missing** and cured at the **fallback** level with a single inserted Section 12.11: at least 90 days of transition assistance available after any expiry or termination, plus return of AbbVie data within 30 days, drafted to prevail over the Section 9.7 destruction election so no contradictory mechanic is left behind. Preferred-only extras (six months, then-current rates, machine-readable format, deletion certification) were deliberately omitted, as were survival and expense tails.
